canary_scope.role: implementation validation only; not a physics result

interpretation_limits: The 54-family cut search is CMS-inspired, not a reproduction of a CMS analysis.
The nominal fixed-efficiency endpoint is a fair benchmark operating point, not the final nuisance-aware sensitivity criterion.
Final paper sensitivity requires a separately frozen background and nuisance-parameter likelihood model.
Plots must say Delphes simulation and train-source-group OOF; they must not claim CMS approval or observed data.

alignment: at least three b-tagged jets among four selected jets
Higgs-candidate masses, mHH, Higgs pT, deltaRbb, and absolute deltaEtaHH are analysis observables
low- and high-mHH categorization is used
resolved HH to 4b uses AK4 jets and b-tag multiplicity
signal and control regions are defined in the two-Higgs-candidate mass plane
a multivariate signal-versus-background classifier is used for final extraction

hep_hyperparameter_optimization.alignment: automated bounded optimization is preferable to manual post-hoc threshold choice

particle_transformer.alignment: particle-level attention models motivate a separate high-capacity benchmark rather than expanding the hand-cut family without bound

spanet_multi_higgs.alignment: high-capacity symmetry-aware assignment is a later model baseline; the rectangular cut study remains an interpretable reconstruction-and-selection comparator

next: implement and run the bounded deterministic canary under this clarified true-nested protocol
purpose: remove ambiguity in the phrase pooled inner-OOF selection before implementing or evaluating the optimizer

escalate_before_paper_export_if_any: difference between the two most frequent families is below 0.15
any optional variable inclusion frequency lies between 0.30 and 0.70
the five outer folds do not have a unique modal family

for_each_outer_fold_k: Hold source_fold == k completely untouched for the outer performance evaluation.
For every predeclared family f and every inner-held-out fold j among the four outer-development folds, optimize thresholds theta[k,j,f] using only the other three inner-training folds.
Apply theta[k,j,f] once to inner-held-out fold j and store its comparison-weighted and support metrics.
Pool the four inner-held-out predictions for family f. Choose the family f_star[k] using only these pooled cross-fitted predictions and the frozen primary endpoint and tie-breaking.
After choosing f_star[k], refit its thresholds once on all four outer-development folds with the same frozen search, objective, constraints, and tie-breaking. Call the result theta_star[k].
Apply theta_star[k] once to the untouched outer fold k. Do not use the outer-fold result to change the family, thresholds, variables, or search settings.
true_nested_protocol.forbidden_shortcut: Do not optimize one threshold vector on all four outer-development folds and call its evaluation on those same rows inner OOF.
true_nested_protocol.pooled_inner_oof_definition: concatenation of the four predictions produced when each inner fold was held out from threshold optimization
